description: The full binary-word tree is countable; for each natural n its level n is finite and has exactly 2 to the n nodes.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.binaryTree_levels :
  Countable (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool).carrier ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool) ↑n).Finite ∧
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool) ↑n).ncard =
          2 ^ n
